decisions.statement: Which values those are is read from the check refusing an unused export.
A value nothing names at all keeps its `export`.
A value only a test names keeps its `export`.
The whole tree is searched rather than a path handed in.
The rung dropping the keyword is reached once for each file rather than once for each name.
A run drops the keyword in at most the count of files handed in.
A path handed in to leave alone keeps every keyword that path has.
The files are walked in the order their paths sort.
A route module keeps the `export` on every name React Router reaches.
A file spelling no `export` is left unread.
